docs.title: Setup Instructions
docs.text:
The Talaria 6 family is a suite of comprehensive SoCs featuring ultra-low-power Wi-Fi 7, multi-protocol connectivity, and enhanced cybersecurity. By integrating the high-performance Green Tea Studio™ (GTS) development environment, the Talaria 6 platform provides a trusted, secure, and fast path to commercial-grade IoT solutions.

For an overview, please refer to the Introduction.

docs.title: Product Documentation
docs.text: InnoPhase IoT's Talaria product family is built on a common platform that provides shared Wi-Fi, BLE, and security capabilities. Each product variant extends this platform with specific features.

docs.title: Product Lines
docs.text: Product Description Status He Ultra-low-power Wi-Fi SoC for IoT sensors Production Ne Multi-protocol SoC with Wi-Fi + BLE Sampling Yo High-performance SoC for edge computing Development

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
All products share:

  • Common Wi-Fi 7 radio subsystem
  • Shared security engine (TrustZone)
  • Green Tea Studio™ development environment
  • Unified SDK and API surface

Product-specific sections cover unique peripherals, register maps, and application notes.

docs.title: Application Processor Subsystem
docs.text: This section covers the multi-core application processor (AP) subsystem available in high-end Talaria variants.

docs.title: Subsystem Architecture
docs.text:
The AP subsystem consists of:

  • Dual-core ARM Cortex-M33 running at 160MHz
  • Dedicated DSP for voice and signal processing
  • Shared L3 cache and memory controller

docs.title: Low Latency SoC
docs.text: The Talaria Low Latency variant is optimized for real-time control applications where deterministic response times are critical.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Ultra-Fast Wakeup: < 100μs from deep sleep to active radio.
  • Priority Queueing: Hardware-level packet prioritization for control loops.
  • Deterministic Latency: Guaranteed sub-millisecond round-trip times.

docs.title: Common Platform
docs.text: The Talaria common platform provides the foundation for all InnoPhase IoT products (He, Ne, Yo).

docs.title: Wi-Fi Subsystem
docs.text:
The integrated Wi-Fi 7 radio supports:

  • 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be
  • 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz dual-band operation
  • Ultra-low-power modes (< 1 mA in connected standby)

docs.title: Security Engine
docs.text:
All products include a hardware-accelerated security engine:

  • AES-128/256 encryption
  • SHA-256 hashing
  • TrustZone secure boot
  • Secure key storage (OTP)

docs.title: Green Tea Studio™ (GTS)
docs.text:
GTS is the unified development environment for all Talaria products. It includes:

  • Eclipse-based IDE
  • Real-time debugging
  • Over-the-air (OTA) update framework
  • Power profiler

docs.title: He — Ultra-Low-Power Wi-Fi SoC
docs.text:
The He is InnoPhase IoT's flagship ultra-low-power Wi-Fi SoC, designed for battery-operated IoT sensors and smart home devices.

The Talaria 6 family features ultra-low-power Wi-Fi 7 and multi-protocol connectivity, providing a secure path for commercial-grade IoT solutions.

For an overview, please refer to the Introduction.

docs.title: Key Specifications
docs.text: Parameter Value Frequency 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi Standard 802.11b/g/n Active Rx Current 28 mA Sleep Current < 1 µA Flash 4 MB embedded Package QFN-40

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Install Green Tea Studio™
  2. Connect the He evaluation board via USB
  3. Flash the default firmware: gts flash --target he --image default.bin

docs.title: Shared Platform Features
docs.text:
The He includes all Common Platform capabilities, including:

  • Wi-Fi 7 radio subsystem
  • Hardware security engine
  • OTA update framework

docs.title: Ne — Multi-Protocol Wi-Fi + BLE SoC
docs.text: The Ne is InnoPhase IoT's multi-protocol SoC combining Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Low Energy for connected devices requiring dual-radio capability.

docs.title: Key Specifications
docs.text: Parameter Value Frequency 2.4 GHz / 5 GHz Wi-Fi Standard 802.11a/b/g/n/ac BLE Bluetooth 5.3 Active Rx Current 35 mA (Wi-Fi) / 8 mA (BLE) Sleep Current < 2 µA Flash 8 MB embedded Package QFN-56

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Install Green Tea Studio™
  2. Connect the Ne evaluation board via USB
  3. Flash the default firmware: gts flash --target ne --image default.bin

docs.title: Shared Platform Features
docs.text:
The Ne includes all Common Platform capabilities, plus:

  • Dual-band Wi-Fi radio
  • BLE 5.3 with direction finding
  • Concurrent Wi-Fi + BLE operation

docs.title: Yo — High-Performance Edge Computing SoC
docs.text:
The Yo is InnoPhase IoT's high-performance SoC designed for edge AI and gateway applications requiring significant compute power alongside wireless connectivity.

The Talaria 6 family features ultra-low-power Wi-Fi 7 and multi-protocol connectivity, providing a secure path for commercial-grade IoT solutions.

docs.title: Key Specifications
docs.text: Parameter Value Frequency 2.4 GHz / 5 GHz / 6 GHz Wi-Fi Standard 802.11be (Wi-Fi 7) BLE Bluetooth 5.4 CPU Dual-core Arm Cortex-M33 @ 240 MHz RAM 2 MB SRAM Flash 16 MB embedded Package BGA-144

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Install Green Tea Studio™
  2. Connect the Yo evaluation board via USB-C
  3. Flash the default firmware: gts flash --target yo --image default.bin

docs.title: Shared Platform Features
docs.text:
The Yo includes all Common Platform capabilities, plus:

  • Wi-Fi 7 with MLO (Multi-Link Operation)
  • Edge AI accelerator (TinyML inference)
  • USB 2.0 host/device
  • Ethernet MAC interface
